Scripture is understood to have had both human & divine authors, so there are times when a prophecy or text may carry dimensions of meaning that extend beyond what the human author could have fully comprehended in their own day. There are numerous examples of OT messianic prophecies that are reinterpreted by both Jesus & the apostolic NT writers in the light of Christ (eg. 1 Peter 1:10-12).

Even in these cases, though, sound theology maintains that the ultimate fulfilment complements & expands the original context rather than contradicting or reinventing it.
